children: On August 27, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, violating Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Trading continues on the Nasdaq Capital Market under AUID, and the company has until February 23, 2027 to regain compliance, which may include a reverse stock split.
